glyph_origin: Possibly the original character of 旁 (“side”), with its form related to 巫. 巫 depicts four extremities with indicator symbols, being the original character of 荒 in 四荒. Compared to 巫, one end of this character lacks the indicator symbol and is elongated to denote "side" 旁. 方 in 四方 and 荒 in 四荒 may be cognates. It is unrelated to 㫃 (“fluttering flag”), from which characters like 旗 (“flag”) and 旅 (“troops”) are derived.
senses: [fāng] (obsolete) joined boats; a raft; to cross by raft or boat
[páng] (only in compounds) used in 方羊, 方佯, 方洋: to wander, to roam; to soar
